properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Land within an existing residential area that is part occupied by an existing dwelling with the remainder being vacant hardstanding and rough ground, occupied by a single dilapidated outbuilding. The western part of the site is occupied by a bungalow and associated land, the central and eastern elements are derelict land previously occupied by commercial uses. This land had a number of uses prior to clearance, included a gym, supermarket and stables, all now cleared. Potential to provide an infill scheme, either in whole or part. If the whole site is redevelopment, demolition of the existing property likely to be part of an intensification scheme. Identified for redevelopment for a number of years. An outline permission was secured in 2003 for construction of 10 homes on the vacant land (03/00250/OUT). This lapsed without a start being made. More recently, an outline application has been submitted for clearance and development of 16 dwellings and is now pending consideration (18/02329/OUT). If permitted and then progressed, the development will deliver 15 net additional homes. This relates to the whole site. If the current application is permitted, the deliverability of development will be reappraised.
properties.site-address: 7C Netherton Lane and land to the east and south east, Bedlington
